title: Free food places in the Coachella Valley
lead: Food pantries, mobile markets and hot meals. Search or filter, then call or get directions.
contactTitle: Need help? Contact FIND Food Bank
contactLead: FIND Food Bank keeps the list of places and the monthly Mobile Market calendar. They can help if a place has no phone number or if you are not sure where to go.
contactHours: Phone hours: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 4:30 PM.
footer1: A student project for the California State Seal of Civic Engagement. Not run by FIND Food Bank.
footer2: Information comes from FIND Food Bank's public map page and its monthly Mobile Market calendar. Hours can change, so please call before you go.
footer3: This site does not collect any personal information.

flyer.description: Print a flyer with a QR code and FIND Food Bank's phone number to help people find free food.
flyerLead: Print this page and post it where people wait: the laundromat, the clinic, the church, the school office. Anyone can scan the code or call the number.
flyerStep1: Print on letter paper. Black and white is fine, and it photocopies well.
flyerStep2: Cut the strips at the bottom along the lines so people can take the number with them.
flyerStep3: Ask before you put it up on a board.
flyerNoJs: To print, use your browser's menu (Ctrl+P or ⌘P).
sheetScan: Scan with your phone camera to see food pantries, mobile markets and hot meals, and which places are open today.
sheetNoInternet: No internet? Call FIND Food Bank
sheetPrivacy: This site is free and does not collect any personal information.
